result.reason: The added operative insurance covenant satisfies every preferred requirement and therefore also satisfies the lower fallback limits. It leaves the original headings and counterparts provision unchanged and adds only insurance-related terms. Drafting is clear, with the minor terminology point that it uses “Company data” rather than the playbook's “Customer Data”; in context, the clause expressly covers HDI's processing of the Company's data and is substantively sufficient.
